notes: Everything is set in capitals in one monospaced face, as the reference: long German service descriptions read slower than in a text face.
The header's name and menu stand on ink chips and the first picture carries a 66 % ink scrim under the h1 — both departures from the reference for the readability gate.
A client whose large photographs are all under 690 px high gets no first picture, band or list half (they are left out, not enlarged past 1.3x).
